description: The collectors that do not run hourly: the storm sweep, the dungeon cooldowns and weekly discovery, the twice-daily wheel of affluence, and the grand tournament

panels.description: One row per collector over the selected range. A job missing from this table did not run at all

targets.expr: sum by (job) (count_over_time({job=~"update-storm-map|update-dungeons-list|discover-new-dungeons|wheel-of-affluence|grand-tournament|global-rankings-refresh|outer-realms-data-fetch|outer-realms-and-beyond-the-horizon-event-history"}[$__range]))

sum by (job) (count_over_time({job=~"update-storm-map|update-dungeons-list|discover-new-dungeons|wheel-of-affluence|grand-tournament|global-rankings-refresh|outer-realms-data-fetch|outer-realms-and-beyond-the-horizon-event-history", level="error"}[$__range])) or (sum by (job) (count_over_time({job=~"update-storm-map|update-dungeons-list|discover-new-dungeons|wheel-of-affluence|grand-tournament|global-rankings-refresh|outer-realms-data-fetch|outer-realms-and-beyond-the-horizon-event-history"}[$__range])) * 0)

sum by (job) (sum_over_time({job=~"update-storm-map|update-dungeons-list|discover-new-dungeons|wheel-of-affluence|grand-tournament|global-rankings-refresh|outer-realms-data-fetch|outer-realms-and-beyond-the-horizon-event-history"} | json criticalErrors="criticalErrors" | unwrap criticalErrors [$__range]))

avg by (job) (avg_over_time({job=~"update-storm-map|update-dungeons-list|discover-new-dungeons|wheel-of-affluence|grand-tournament|global-rankings-refresh|outer-realms-data-fetch|outer-realms-and-beyond-the-horizon-event-history"} | json durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__range]))

max by (job) (max_over_time({job=~"update-storm-map|update-dungeons-list|discover-new-dungeons|wheel-of-affluence|grand-tournament|global-rankings-refresh|outer-realms-data-fetch|outer-realms-and-beyond-the-horizon-event-history"} | json durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__range]))

panels.title: Job summary

panels.description: When each collector ran. The storm and dungeon workers loop every two minutes, the wheel twice a day, the grand tournament hourly while an event is open

targets.expr: sum by (job) (count_over_time({job=~"update-storm-map|update-dungeons-list|discover-new-dungeons|wheel-of-affluence|grand-tournament|global-rankings-refresh|outer-realms-data-fetch|outer-realms-and-beyond-the-horizon-event-history"}[$__auto]))

panels.title: Runs per job

panels.description: Servers the storm worker swept at least once in range

targets.expr: count(count by (server) (count_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Servers scanned

panels.description: Storm map scans completed. The worker loops every two minutes over every storm server

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="update-storm-map"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Sweeps

panels.description: Scans that ended on a critical error. The map keeps the state of the last good sweep

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="update-storm-map", level="error"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed sweeps

panels.description: Storm forts currently held in the map, summed over every server

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", forts="forts" | unwrap forts [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Forts tracked

panels.description: Resource isles a player is sitting on right now, out of every isle scanned

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", occupiedIsles="occupiedIsles" | unwrap occupiedIsles [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Isles occupied

panels.description: Monthly rollovers applied in range. Expect exactly one per storm server, just after the reset

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json seasonRollover="seasonRollover" | seasonRollover="true" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Season wipes

panels.description: The state of each storm map as of its last sweep. A radius that stops growing while the border was never reached means the scan is being cut short

targets.expr: sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", forts="forts" | unwrap forts [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", lockedForts="lockedForts" | unwrap lockedForts [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", isles="isles" | unwrap isles [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", occupiedIsles="occupiedIsles" | unwrap occupiedIsles [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", radius="radius" | unwrap radius [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__range]))

panels.title: Storm map by server

panels.description: Forts and isles the sweep is finding. A step down without a season wipe is a scan that came back short

targets.expr: sum(sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", forts="forts" | unwrap forts [$__auto])))
sum(sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", isles="isles" | unwrap isles [$__auto])))
sum(sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", occupiedIsles="occupiedIsles" | unwrap occupiedIsles [$__auto])))

panels.title: Storm objects over time

panels.description: Worst sweep per interval. The worker is serial, so the sum of these is what one cycle costs

targets.expr: sum by (server) (max_over_time({job="update-storm-map"} | json server="server", durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__auto]))

panels.title: Sweep duration by server

panels.description: Passes of updateDungeonsList, which refreshes the dungeons whose cooldown has expired

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="update-dungeons-list"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cooldown sweeps

panels.description: Dungeon rows the cooldown sweeps rewrote

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="update-dungeons-list"} | json dungeonsUpdated="dungeonsUpdated" | unwrap dungeonsUpdated [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Dungeons refreshed

panels.description: Cooldown sweeps that ended on a critical error

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="update-dungeons-list", level="error"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed sweeps

panels.description: Weekly passes that look for dungeons which spawned since the last scan. One per server per week

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="discover-new-dungeons"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Discovery passes

panels.description: Dungeons the weekly pass found and inserted

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="discover-new-dungeons"} | json dungeonsFound="dungeonsFound" | unwrap dungeonsFound [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Dungeons discovered

panels.description: Discovery tiles the game never returned. Any of these leaves the server due for another pass

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="discover-new-dungeons"} | json tilesFailed="tilesFailed" | unwrap tilesFailed [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Tiles that never answered

panels.description: The weekly discovery, per server. Zero tiles scanned is the normal answer on a settled server: every realm castle already sits inside a box an earlier pass covered

targets.expr: sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="discover-new-dungeons"} | json server="server", tilesScanned="tilesScanned" | unwrap tilesScanned [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="discover-new-dungeons"} | json server="server", tilesFailed="tilesFailed" | unwrap tilesFailed [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="discover-new-dungeons"} | json server="server", dungeonsFound="dungeonsFound" | unwrap dungeonsFound [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="discover-new-dungeons"} | json server="server", durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__range]))

panels.title: Last discovery pass by server

panels.description: How long each server takes to refresh its expired dungeons. Growth here is the dungeon table growing, not a fault

targets.expr: sum by (server) (max_over_time({job="update-dungeons-list"} | json server="server", durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__auto]))

panels.title: Cooldown sweep duration by server

panels.description: Wheel rankings collected. The cron fires twice a day across every server

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Collections

panels.description: Servers the collector reached in range

targets.expr: count(count by (server) (count_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json server="server" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Servers collected

panels.description: Collections that gave up after three retries

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence", level="error"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed collections

panels.description: Servers whose last collection found the wheel open. Zero everywhere simply means the event is not running

targets.expr: count(count by (server) (count_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json server="server", eventActive="eventActive" | eventActive="true" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Servers running the event

panels.description: Rows written across every collection in range

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json entriesStored="entriesStored" | unwrap entriesStored [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Entrants stored

panels.description: Difference between what the game announced and what was stored, summed over the range. Anything but zero means a page was lost

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json entriesAnnounced="entriesAnnounced" | unwrap entriesAnnounced [$__range])) - sum(sum_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json entriesStored="entriesStored" | unwrap entriesStored [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Entrants missed

panels.description: What the most recent wheel collection stored on each server. Announced above stored is a page the pager walked past

targets.expr: sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json server="server", entriesStored="entriesStored" | unwrap entriesStored [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json server="server", entriesAnnounced="entriesAnnounced" | unwrap entriesAnnounced [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json server="server", durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__range]))
sum by (server) (last_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json server="server", criticalErrors="criticalErrors" | unwrap criticalErrors [$__range]))

panels.title: Last collection by server

panels.description: Wheel participation as the collector sees it. Two spikes a day is the expected shape; a flat line while the event runs is a collector that stopped

targets.expr: sum by (server) (sum_over_time({job="wheel-of-affluence"} | json server="server", entriesStored="entriesStored" | unwrap entriesStored [$__auto]))

panels.title: Entrants collected

panels.description: Collections of the tournament standings. The job runs from the DE1 fill, so once an hour

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="grand-tournament"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Runs

panels.description: Event id the last run wrote into. It is bumped when the previous event is more than a day old

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="grand-tournament"} | json server="server", eventId="eventId" | unwrap eventId [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Current event

panels.description: Alliance standings the last run inserted. Five divisions, so a healthy run is in the hundreds while an event is open

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="grand-tournament"} | json server="server", grandTournamentRecordsInserted="grandTournamentRecordsInserted" | unwrap grandTournamentRecordsInserted [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Alliances recorded

panels.description: Subdivisions the last run walked before each division answered empty

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="grand-tournament"} | json server="server", subdivisions="subdivisions" | unwrap subdivisions [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Subdivisions scanned

panels.description: Runs that ended on a critical error

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="grand-tournament", level="error"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed runs

panels.description: How long the last collection took

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="grand-tournament"} | json server="server", durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Run duration

panels.description: Falls to a handful between tournaments and climbs into the hundreds while one is open, so this doubles as the event calendar

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="grand-tournament"} | json grandTournamentRecordsInserted="grandTournamentRecordsInserted" | unwrap grandTournamentRecordsInserted [$__auto]))

panels.title: Alliances recorded per run

panels.description: The closing record of each tournament collection, newest first

targets.expr: {job="grand-tournament"} | json | line_format "event {{.eventId}} - {{.grandTournamentRecordsInserted}} alliances over {{.subdivisions}} subdivisions in {{.durationMs}}ms"

panels.title: Recent runs

panels.description: How long REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW global_ranking takes. It runs from the DE1 fill and blocks nothing, but a climb here is the cross-server ranking getting expensive

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({job="global-rankings-refresh"} | json durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__auto]))

panels.title: Global ranking refresh

panels.description: Duration of the two event-history collectors, per run

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({job="outer-realms-data-fetch"} | json durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__auto]))
max(max_over_time({job="outer-realms-and-beyond-the-horizon-event-history"} | json durationMs="durationMs" | unwrap durationMs [$__auto]))

panels.title: Outer realms and beyond the horizon

panels.description: Every job record that closed with a critical error, across all collectors on this dashboard

targets.expr: {job=~"update-storm-map|update-dungeons-list|discover-new-dungeons|wheel-of-affluence|grand-tournament|global-rankings-refresh|outer-realms-data-fetch|outer-realms-and-beyond-the-horizon-event-history", level="error"} | json | line_format "[{{.server}}] {{.criticalErrors}} critical error(s) after {{.durationMs}}ms"

panels.title: Job failures

title: Scraping jobs
